question: What are the eligibility criteria and required documents for PM-KISAN scheme?
expectedAnswer: Small and marginal landholding farmer families with cultivable land up to 2 hectares (now all landholding farmer families subject to exclusions). Required documents: Aadhaar card, land ownership records (Khasra/Khatauni), Aadhaar-linked active bank account with IFSC code, and mobile number. Institutional landholders and income-tax payers are excluded.
conflictOrCaveat: Income tax payers and institutional landholders are strictly excluded.

question: PM-KISAN me eKYC kaise karein aur kya documents chahiye?
expectedAnswer: PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) par jakar OTP-based eKYC karein ya nearest CSC center par jakar biometric eKYC karwayein. PM-KISAN mobile app se Face Authentication bhi ho sakta hai. Required documents: Aadhaar number aur Aadhaar-linked registered mobile number.
conflictOrCaveat: eKYC is mandatory to receive installments.

question: पीएम किसान सम्मान निधि योजना के लिए कौन से किसान अपात्र (ineligible) हैं?
expectedAnswer: संस्थागत भूमि धारक, संवैधानिक पद धारक, केंद्र/राज्य सरकार के नियमित कर्मचारी, ₹10,000 से अधिक मासिक पेंशनभोगी, पिछले वर्ष आयकर देने वाले व्यक्ति, एवं डॉक्टर, वकील, इंजीनियर, सीए जैसे पंजीकृत पेशेवर अपात्र हैं।
conflictOrCaveat: Income tax payers cannot claim PM-KISAN.

question: What is the mandatory cut-off date of land ownership for PM-KISAN?
expectedAnswer: The cut-off date for determination of eligibility of beneficiaries under PM-KISAN is February 1, 2019. Any land transfer/purchase after this date is not eligible for benefits, except in case of succession due to death of landowner.
conflictOrCaveat: Purchased land after Feb 1, 2019 is barred from PM-KISAN.

question: What are the key state horticulture schemes implemented by the Chhattisgarh government?
expectedAnswer: Key Chhattisgarh state-funded horticulture schemes include: Potato Production Demonstration Scheme, Spice Cultivation & Expansion Scheme (Chilli, Ginger, Garlic, Turmeric, Coriander), Fruit Area Expansion Scheme, Micro-irrigation assistance, and vegetable cluster demonstrations via agriportal.cg.nic.in/horticulture.
conflictOrCaveat: These are state-funded schemes distinct from Central MIDH/RKVY.

question: छत्तीसगढ़ राज्य पोषित आलू उत्पादन योजना में क्या सहायता मिलती है?
expectedAnswer: छत्तीसगढ़ की आलू उत्पादन योजना के तहत प्रमाणित बीज कंद (certified seed tubers) पर अनुदान, तकनीकी प्रदर्शन, उन्नत उत्पादन पद्धतियों का मार्गदर्शन तथा प्रति हेक्टेयर निर्धारित लागत सीमा पर सब्सिडी प्रदान की जाती है।
conflictOrCaveat: Administered by CG State Directorate of Horticulture.

question: CG mein Masala Kshetra Vistar yojana kya hai aur kaunsi fasal cover hoti hai?
expectedAnswer: Chhattisgarh Masala Kshetra Vistar (Spice Expansion) yojana ke antargat masalon jaise mirch (chilli), adrak (ginger), lahsun (garlic), haldi (turmeric) aur dhaniya (coriander) ki kheti par beej/ropar samagri aur subsidy milti hai.
conflictOrCaveat: Targeted at spice diversification in eligible districts.

question: What assistance is provided under MIDH (Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture) in Chhattisgarh?
expectedAnswer: Under MIDH (Centrally Sponsored Scheme), assistance of up to 50% subsidy is provided for protected cultivation (polyhouse, shade net houses), high-density fruit plantations, drip irrigation, pack houses, and cold storage units.
conflictOrCaveat: MIDH is a centrally sponsored 60:40 scheme.

question: What is the funding pattern between Centre and State for RKVY in Chhattisgarh?
expectedAnswer: Under Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAFTAAR), the funding pattern between the Central Government and the State of Chhattisgarh is 60:40 (60% Central share and 40% State share).
conflictOrCaveat: Hill and NE states have 90:10, but CG is standard 60:40.

question: राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा मिशन (NFSM) के तहत छत्तीसगढ़ के किसानों को क्या लाभ मिलता है?
expectedAnswer: NFSM के अंतर्गत प्रमाणित/उन्नत धान एवं दलहन बीज पर सब्सिडी, फसल प्रदर्शन (cluster demonstration), कृषि यंत्र जैसे सीड ड्रिल, जीरो-टिल मशीन, तथा अम्लीय भूमि सुधार हेतु जिप्सम/चूना सहायता मिलती है।
conflictOrCaveat: Chhattisgarh is a priority state for NFSM-Rice and Pulses.

question: How can a farmer apply for horticulture subsidies in Chhattisgarh and what documents are required?
expectedAnswer: Farmers can apply online through agriportal.cg.nic.in/horticulture or nearest CSC/Lok Sewa Kendra, or offline via Block Senior Horticulture Development Officer (SHDO) or RHEO. Required documents: Aadhaar card, Land records (B-1 and Khasra P-II), Aadhaar-linked bank passbook with IFSC, passport photos, and water source proof for irrigation.
conflictOrCaveat: SC/ST farmers must attach caste certificate for enhanced subsidy.

question: उद्यानिकी योजना के लिए ऑफलाइन आवेदन किस अधिकारी के पास जमा करना होता है?
expectedAnswer: विकासखंड (block) स्तर पर वरिष्ठ उद्यान विकास अधिकारी (SHDO) अथवा ग्रामीण उद्यान विस्तार अधिकारी (RHEO) के कार्यालय में, या जिला स्तर पर सहायक संचालक उद्यानिकी कार्यालय में जमा करना होता है।
conflictOrCaveat: Offline verification must be certified by field officer.

question: Kisan portal CG par registration ke liye kya B-1 aur Khasra nakal jaruri hai?
expectedAnswer: Haan, Chhattisgarh kisan portal aur udyaniki yojanaon mein apply karne ke liye B-1 (khatiyan) aur Khasra P-II nakal land record verification ke liye bilkul anivarya (mandatory) documents hain, saath mein Aadhaar aur bank passbook bhi chahiye.
conflictOrCaveat: Must be certified land records from Bhuiyan portal.

question: What is the procedure for new farmer registration on the PM-KISAN portal?
expectedAnswer: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click 'New Farmer Registration'. Select Rural or Urban farmer, enter Aadhaar number and mobile number, verify with OTP, fill in State/District/Block/Village and land details (survey/khasra number, area), upload land document, and submit.
conflictOrCaveat: Registration requires state nodal agency verification.

question: How to identify and manage blast disease in paddy crop?
expectedAnswer: Paddy blast (Pyricularia oryzae) shows spindle-shaped lesions with brown borders and grey centers on leaves, neck blast, and node rot. Management: avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer, treat seeds, and spray Tricyclazole 75% WP (0.6 g/L) or Azoxystrobin at early symptom onset.
conflictOrCaveat: Do not spray banned organochlorines; use protective gear.

question: टमाटर में फल छेदक (Fruit Borer) कीट का नियंत्रण कैसे करें?
expectedAnswer: टमाटर में फल छेदक (Helicoverpa armigera) नियंत्रण हेतु: फेरोमोन ट्रैप (12 प्रति हेक्टेयर) लगाएं, प्रभावित फलों को नष्ट करें, जैविक नियंत्रण हेतु नीम तेल (Neem oil 1500 ppm) का छिड़काव करें, अथवा क्लोरेंट्रानिलिप्रोल (Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC) 0.3 मिली प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर छिड़कें।
conflictOrCaveat: Wait for waiting period before harvesting post-chemical spray.

question: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) par byaj dar kitni lagti hai aur timely repayment par kitna discount milta hai?
expectedAnswer: KCC par basic interest rate 7% per annum hota hai. Government of India 3% prompt repayment incentive (interest subvention) deti hai, isliye samay par loan chukane par effective interest rate sirf 4% per annum lagta hai.
conflictOrCaveat: 4% is valid only when repaid within stipulated due date.

question: What is the Soil Health Card scheme and how often is soil testing recommended?
expectedAnswer: Soil Health Card is a Government of India scheme providing farmers with crop-wise nutrient status across 12 parameters (N, P, K, secondary, micronutrients, pH, EC). Soil testing is conducted in a 2-year cycle free of charge for participating farmers.
conflictOrCaveat: Samples collected by agriculture department field staff.

question: छत्तीसगढ़ में ड्रिप एवं स्प्रिंकलर सूक्ष्म सिंचाई योजना पर कितना अनुदान मिलता है?
expectedAnswer: प्रधानमंत्री कृषि सिंचाई योजना (PMKSY) एवं राज्य योजना के तहत लघु एवं सीमांत किसानों को 55% तक तथा अन्य बड़े किसानों को 45% तक ड्रिप एवं स्प्रिंकलर सिंचाई प्रणालियों पर अनुदान प्रदान किया जाता है।
sourceTitle: केंद्रीय एवं राज्य सूक्ष्म सिंचाई योजना
conflictOrCaveat: Water source proof is mandatory during application.

question: पीएम किसान योजना में सालाना कितनी राशि मिलती है और कितनी किश्तों में दी जाती है?
expectedAnswer: पीएम-किसान सम्मान निधि योजना के तहत पात्र किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 की वित्तीय सहायता दी जाती है, जो कि ₹2,000 की 3 समान किश्तों में सीधे बैंक खाते (DBT) में भेजी जाती है।
conflictOrCaveat: Aadhaar-seeded bank account is required.

question: उद्यानिकी विभाग छत्तीसगढ़ के बारे में जानकारी और संपर्क सूत्र क्या है?
expectedAnswer: छत्तीसगढ़ उद्यानिकी संचालनालय की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट agriportal.cg.nic.in/horticulture है। किसान विकासखंड स्तर पर SHDO/RHEO कार्यालय में या किसान कॉल सेंटर के टोल-फ्री नंबर 1800-180-1551 पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं।
conflictOrCaveat: Official helpline is active all days 6 AM to 10 PM.

question: Kisan credit card lene ke liye kaun kaun se documents bank mein jama karne hote hain?
expectedAnswer: KCC ke liye bank mein: Bhumi ke dastavez (B-1, Khasra/Khatauni nakal), Aadhaar card, PAN card ya voter ID, passport photo, crop declaration form aur bank dwara manga gaya application form jama karna hota hai.
conflictOrCaveat: Tenant farmers need notarized declaration or agreement.

question: Polyhouse aur shade net lagane ke liye Chhattisgarh mein kitna subsidy milta hai?
expectedAnswer: Chhattisgarh mein MIDH (Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture) ke antargat naturally ventilated polyhouse aur shade net house lagane par cost norm ka 50% tak subsidy di jaati hai.
conflictOrCaveat: Prior approval from district horticulture committee needed.

question: Dhan ki fasal mein khad ka santulit matra (NPK) kya hona chahiye?
expectedAnswer: Dhan (paddy) ke liye standard NPK anupat lagbhag 100-120:50-60:40 kg/ha recommend kiya jaata hai. Urea ko 3 split doses mein dein (basal, tillering, panicle initiation) aur zinc ki kami hone par 25 kg/ha zinc sulphate dein.
conflictOrCaveat: Soil health card report takes precedence over generalized doses.

question: pm kissan samman nidhy me daby kyc kaise karwaye
expectedAnswer: PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) par eKYC OTP se karein ya nearest CSC center jakar biometric fingerprint/iris se karwayein. Mobile app se face auth bhi available hai.
conflictOrCaveat: Tolerates spelling errors (kissan, nidhy, daby).

question: tmatar me kida lag gaya h kya dwai dale
expectedAnswer: Tamatar mein fruit borer ya keede ke liye pheromone traps lagayein, Neem oil 1500 ppm ka chhidkav karein, ya block udyaniki officer (SHDO/RHEO) ki salah se approved keetnashak dalein.
conflictOrCaveat: Tolerates typos (tmatar, kida, dwai).

question: chhatisgard udhyaniki yojana me aalu subsdy kitni h
expectedAnswer: Chhattisgarh udyaniki vibhag ki aalu utpadan pradarshan (potato scheme) ke tahat certified beej kand par subsidy aur takneeki pradarshan sahayata milti hai. SHDO block office se sampark karein.
conflictOrCaveat: Tolerates typos (chhatisgard, udhyaniki, aalu, subsdy).

question: yojana ka paisa kab aayega
expectedAnswer: Yojana (jaise PM-KISAN) ki installment status check karne ke liye pmkisan.gov.in par 'Know Your Status' section mein apna registration number aur captcha dalein. Bank account Aadhaar-seeded hona jaruri hai.
conflictOrCaveat: Ambiguous query resolved by referencing official portal status tool.

question: Can a tenant farmer without any land records get a free 65 HP tractor in Raipur under the 2026 Free Tractor scheme?
expectedAnswer: No, this information cannot be verified. There is no official 'Free 65 HP Tractor Scheme' providing 100% free tractors without land records. Official farm mechanization schemes (SMAM/RKVY) only provide 20% to 50% subsidy on purchase through registered portals with verified documents.
conflictOrCaveat: HALLUCINATION TRAP: Must not invent free tractor scheme.

question: क्या छत्तीसगढ़ सरकार तरबूज उगाने वाले किसानों को ₹50 लाख का नकद बोनस दे रही है?
expectedAnswer: नहीं, यह जानकारी आधिकारिक संदर्भ में उपलब्ध नहीं है और इसे सत्यापित नहीं किया जा सकता। छत्तीसगढ़ सरकार द्वारा तरबूज उगाने पर ऐसा कोई ₹50 लाख का नकद बोनस नहीं दिया जाता। उद्यानिकी विभाग केवल मानक क्षेत्र विस्तार योजनाओं में निर्धारित अनुदान देता है।
conflictOrCaveat: HALLUCINATION TRAP: Must reject false 50 lakh claim.

question: Kisan ko helicopter se urea chhidkav karne ke liye government 90% subsidy de rahi hai kya?
expectedAnswer: Nahi, aisi koi helicopter subsidy scheme sarkar dwara nahi di jaati hai aur yeh claim verified nahi hai. Sarkar keval Kisan Drone yojana (Namo Drone Didi/SMAM) ke antargat SHGs/FPOs ko drone subsidy deti hai.
conflictOrCaveat: HALLUCINATION TRAP: Must not validate helicopter subsidy.

question: Is physical Aadhaar card photocopy submission enough for PM-KISAN, or is biometric/facial eKYC strictly mandatory now?
expectedAnswer: Under current mandatory guidelines, physical submission alone is NOT sufficient. Electronic KYC (eKYC) is strictly mandatory for all beneficiaries to receive PM-KISAN installments. It must be completed via OTP on pmkisan.gov.in, biometric scan at CSC, or facial recognition on PM-KISAN mobile app.
conflictOrCaveat: Old guidelines allowed offline docs; current rule requires eKYC.

question: Can a farmer who purchased new agricultural land in 2021 claim PM-KISAN benefits?
expectedAnswer: No. Under PM-KISAN revised operational guidelines, the mandatory cut-off date of land ownership is February 1, 2019. Any farmer acquiring agricultural land through purchase after 01.02.2019 is ineligible for PM-KISAN, unless the land was acquired by inheritance or succession due to the death of the landowner.
conflictOrCaveat: Strict cut-off prevents new land buyers post-2019 from enrolling.
